verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Devin runs coding tasks in dedicated cloud VMs that persist after the user disconnects (devin-docs-13, devin-docs-1), and community reports corroborate it can work autonomously for extended periods, even days (devin-comm-2). However, hands-on feedback shows significant caveats: it often makes extraneous changes it can't cleanly undo, users must actively monitor and terminate sessions, and there's no reliable 'ask for help' escape hatch, undermining the 'set it and forget it' background delegation ideal (devin-comm-1, devin-comm-2, devin-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent verification of clean isolation/rollback behavior, and evidence that long background runs reliably stay on-task without supervision.
